descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.
 We are looking for 
 We are seeking an experienced R&D IT DevOps / Application Support Engineer to support software engineering teams with secure and efficient build, deploy, test, and release technologies. In this role, you will work with large-scale applications and cloud/on-prem infrastructure, driving automation, reliability, and continuous improvement.
 What you will do: 
Analyzing and solving complex application and infrastructure issues.
Administering, configuring, and supporting engineering applications such as Jenkins, GitHub, and GitHub Actions.
Developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines across multiple environments.
Automating application setup, scaling, and management using Configuration as Code.
Supporting and managing containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Troubleshooting and optimizing application and platform performance.
Implementing security best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
Documenting technical procedures, configurations, and solution architectures.
 What you need to have: 
5+ years of experience in DevOps, SysOps, CloudOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar technical roles.
Hands-on experience with software engineering tools such as Jenkins, GitHub, GitHub Actions, and Terraform.
Strong scripting and automation skills with Python, Bash, and/or Perl.
Experience with Git and Subversion.
Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Good understanding of cloud and on-prem infrastructure, virtualization, and networking.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Good English communication skills, both written and spoken.
 Nice-to-have qualifications: 
Experience supporting large-scale applications used by thousands of users.
Experience with cloud platforms and infrastructure automation.
Knowledge of security and data protection best practices.
Experience working in enterprise software engineering environment
 What's in it for you: 
Extended compensation and benefits package
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit
 We really welcome open-minded and committed people: 
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things;
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do;
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of team spirit.
